requirement.statement: The `kwf agent` scaffold step SHALL inject a compact, self-contained workflow-generation cheatsheet (the Kon DSL node set with their config keys, the input/output mechanics, the critical authoring gotchas, and at least one verified end-to-end example) as the design system prompt. It SHALL NOT inject the slimmed navigation SKILL.md, which no longer carries DSL syntax.

case.given: A user runs `kwf agent` with a requirement string
case.when: The scaffold meta-workflow builds the design system prompt
case.then: The injected document SHALL contain the Kon DSL node syntax (ai_workflow / ai_phase / ai_agent / ai_parallel / ai_pipeline / ai_log) and the authoring gotcha checklist

case.given: SKILL.md has been slimmed to a navigation entry without a DSL reference section
case.when: The scaffold selects what to inject
case.then: It SHALL source the cheatsheet from the dynamic-workflow manual and SHALL NOT fall back to injecting the navigation-only SKILL.md

The cheatsheet SHALL explicitly cover the traps that previously broke generation: ai_agent must sit inside an ai_phase to yield, hyphenated knot names parse as subtraction (use camelCase), and triple-quoted string delimiter / indentation rules
